title: Vectorizing text for Naive Bayes
description: You can follow training text and a query through the same vocabulary.

steps.description: You import the count vectorizer and multinomial classifier. The three documents have labels 1, 1 and 0.
fit_transform learns the vocabulary and encodes the training documents as counts. You fit MultinomialNB with those counts and labels.

steps.question: Does the query call learn a new vocabulary?
steps.answer: No. vec.transform encodes the query using the already fitted vectorizer.

steps.description: You pass the query counts to predict. The supplied output [1] reports label 1 for the single query.
